$description: A deliberately short scale. The dashboard reads at two sizes and writes at three weights; pretending otherwise is where drift starts.

sans.$value: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"
sans.$description: Inter, because the app already loads it. Everything below the first entry is the stock system stack.

mono.$value: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace
mono.$description: Tailwind's stock mono stack, kept verbatim — there is no reason for the system to ship a shorter fallback chain than the framework it sits on.

regular.$description: Body copy only. Rarely written — it is the default.

medium.$description: Labels, nav items, table cells. 1,144 uses — the most-written weight.

heading.$description: Every page title in the dashboard. 20/32.

title.$description: Overlay and section titles — sheet headers, modal headings, empty-state headings. 18/28. Added after the fact: the app uses 18px 99 times, three times more than 20px, so leaving it out was a gap rather than a simplification and rounding those up would have been a change disguised as a migration.

body.$description: The workhorse. 1,705 uses — if a size is unspecified, it is this one. 14/24.

body-touch.$description: Inputs below the sm breakpoint. 16px stops iOS zooming the page on focus. 16/24.

meta.$description: Timestamps, counts, helper text, badge copy. 989 uses. 12/16.
